app.title: Bookshelf – Self-hosted eBook library that runs on object storage
app.author: arbayi
app.description: A self‑hosted eBook library that stores metadata and books on object storage.
proposed_tests: Clone repo and run docker-compose up to start the service
Create a test book file in the object storage bucket
Use the REST API to upload the book and verify it appears in the UI
Run a search query via API and assert the correct result count
Measure API response times for listing books
